content: Hello, I am Meridian Bank's digital assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mx Alex Rowan?
No, Alex is away right now. Could you call back today at half past four?
Could you please confirm that you would like me to call back today at 4:30?
Actually, it's already half past four, so make it five o'clock today instead.
I am sorry, that time is not possible. Would Thursday 15 October 2026 or Monday 19 October 2026 between 08:30 and 16:30 work instead?
I'm not sure what Alex has planned those days, so I'd rather not commit on their behalf. Could you just try them again another time?
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
